Math, Inc. is pleased to introduce OpenGauss, an open source and state of the art autoformalization agent harness for developers and practitioners to accelerate progress at the frontier. It is stronger, faster, and more cost-efficient than off-the-shelf alternatives. On FormalQualBench, running with a 4-hour timeout, it beats HarmonicMath's Aristotle agent with no time limit. Users can stay highly interactive or let it run autonomously, and coordinate many subagents in parallel. Because it is permissively open source, they can also extend, modify, or inspect the system directly.

OpenGauss was developed in close collaboration with maintainers of leading open-source AI tooling for Lean.

FormalQualBench is our new formal mathematics benchmark, designed to reflect the rigor and breadth of a math PhD qualifying exam. It introduces specification-based evaluation, using the Lean FRO's Comparator tool to enforce a much stronger standard of correctness than a bare successful build.

Unlike many private benchmarks wrapped around undisclosed harnesses and marketed to data teams at AI companies, FormalQualBench is open source, measures generally available tools in public configurations, and is aimed at practitioners who want to choose the best systems for pushing the frontier of autoformalization.

Read the evaluation report, inspect the harness on GitHub, or launch the instant-start template for OpenGauss. Please let us know what you think!
